en.settings_blocked_accounts_desc: Review and unblock accounts you blocked.
en.lists_empty: You have not joined any list yet
en.list_timeline_empty: This list has no posts yet
en.list_members_empty: This list has no members yet
en.community_home_empty_desc: This timeline shows posts from Communities you’ve joined.
en.community_timeline_empty: This community has no posts yet
en.community_join_rules_intro: Review and agree to these Community rules. They apply in addition to the X Rules.
en.community_rules_load_failed: Could not load the Community rules. Refresh and try again.
en.community_public_account_required: Only public accounts can join Communities.
en.community_rules_empty: This community has no published rules
en.community_leave_confirm: You will need to join again to restore member access.
en.community_join_request_sent: Join request sent. A moderator must approve it.
en.community_post_visibility: Community posts are public on X and may appear in search, on profiles, and in other timelines.
en.community_post_session_required: Community posts need an active X web session. Sign in to your X account first.
en.community_post_fallback_unsupported: X rejected the community post request. It was not sent as a regular post, and your draft is still saved.
en.settings_lists_desc: Open the timelines of lists you own or follow.
en.settings_link_in_app_desc: When on, links in posts load in a half-screen sheet instead of the system browser.
en.settings_video_autoplay_desc: When on, videos play automatically as they enter the screen. Turn it off to play from the cover.
en.settings_home_video_mute_desc: Home and the video feed share one sound setting. Mute or unmute any post to apply and remember that choice for following posts.
en.settings_video_auto_pip_desc: On a post's detail page, a playing video moves into a floating picture-in-picture window when you scroll it off screen, so you can keep watching while you read the replies. Turn it off to simply pause the video.
en.settings_video_immersive_fill_desc: Use a black background when on, or a soft video backdrop when off. The full frame keeps its original proportions, with playback controls in a fixed footer.
en.video_feed_controls_always_visible_desc: Keep post information and playback controls visible during playback. Tap the video to hide or restore them together.
en.settings_video_control_style_desc: Choose bottom fade controls or the original floating controls.
en.settings_video_control_style_original_de: Rounded floating control bar with the original button layout.
en.settings_video_control_style_spaced_desc: Full-width progress and spaced playback controls at the screen bottom; hidden during playback.
en.settings_sensitive_media: Show media that may contain sensitive content
en.settings_sensitive_media_desc: Sync your X account’s sensitive media preference and apply it in Harmony X.
en.sensitive_media_hidden: Media that may contain sensitive content is hidden
en.settings_video_background_intro: What a fullscreen video does when you leave the app or lock the screen.
en.settings_video_background_audio: Keep playing audio after exit or lock
en.settings_video_background_audio_desc: The picture stays where it is and the sound keeps running, with play, pause and seeking handled from the system media panel.
en.settings_video_background_pip_desc: Leaving the app hands the video to a picture-in-picture window so it keeps playing while you use other apps.
en.settings_media_desc: Choose the quality used for loading, playback, and downloads.
en.settings_media_intro: Photos default to original size, while video quality is selected automatically. Higher quality looks sharper but uses more data. Downloads use the same selection.
en.settings_image_quality_data_saver_desc: Load smaller photos to reduce mobile data use.
en.settings_image_quality_high_desc: Balance sharpness and loading speed for everyday use.
en.settings_image_quality_original_desc: Default option. Load and download photos at their original size.
en.settings_video_quality_smooth_desc: Prefer the lowest bitrate at or above 500kbps for faster, lighter playback.
en.settings_video_quality_high_desc: Default option. Prefer the highest available bitrate.
en.settings_video_quality_auto_desc: Start with a moderate rendition and try lower bitrates first if playback stalls.
en.settings_video_quality_sd_desc: Choose an available standard definition rendition for a balance of clarity and speed.
en.settings_video_quality_ld_desc: Choose the lowest bitrate rendition for slower connections.
en.photo_ocr_unavailable: Text recognition is not supported on this device
en.photo_subject_unavailable: Subject cutout is not supported on this device
en.photo_subject_save_failed: Could not save the transparent sticker
en.gif_save_started: Downloading GIF. Choose Save to Gallery when ready.
en.gif_share_failed: Could not share this GIF. Try again.
en.media_download_started: Downloading. Choose Save to Gallery when ready.
en.media_download_all_started: Downloading all originals. Choose Save to Gallery when ready.
en.download_manager_desc: Track, pause, resume, or delete downloads and clear video cache.
en.download_background_note: When the app goes to the background, the system keeps downloads running as a data transfer task and shows their progress.
en.download_background_limit: The system may still stop a transfer if you force stop the app or power off the device. Incomplete tasks are kept so you can resume them later.
en.download_cache_desc: Remove temporary video files saved for playback. Photos and videos already saved to Gallery stay untouched.
